fields.description: Athlon is Aldar’s activity-led villa and townhouse community in Dubailand. Walking, running and cycling routes connect homes with parks and shared recreation areas. The collection includes three and four bedroom townhouses, standard villas and larger premium villas with distinct layouts.

sources.label: Aldar: Athlon brochure and representative plans
Aldar FY2025 results: project completion estimates

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Athlon villa/townhouse page checked; not the separate Rise by Athlon apartment release.
reviewCoverage.location: Dubailand location confirmed against the dedicated portal project record.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official three-to-six-bedroom villas and three/four-bedroom townhouses; standard/premium plans reviewed.
reviewCoverage.areas: Portal sample sizes recorded by type, not assumed to be universal plot or internal areas.
reviewCoverage.pricing: AED 2.8m is explicitly a portal launch reference, not present inventory.
reviewCoverage.payment: Portal 5/55/40 schedule transcribed; no assumption of the same schedule for all premium releases.
reviewCoverage.handover: Developer FY2025 table visually confirms 2028. Portal narrows this to May, but no universal month asserted.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 75-page brochure inspected visually for representative townhouse, standard-villa and premium-villa plans.

overview: The brochure separates standard and premium villas. Compare the relevant drawing rather than relying on bedroom count alone: the arrangement of reception rooms, service spaces, garden and upper-floor rooms changes between collections.
research.locationNote: The development is in Dubailand. Request the cluster and plot map when reviewing a home; a community-wide location does not establish its distance from a particular clubhouse or road.
research.priceNote: Property Finder quotes an AED 2.8m launch price. It is a historical entry reference, not an offer for currently available inventory. Villa and premium-collection prices differ.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 5% at launch booking, 55% during construction and 40% on completion. Obtain the applicable cluster and property schedule before treating these proportions as an available offer.
research.handoverNote: Aldar’s FY2025 pipeline lists completion in 2028. Property Finder states May 2028. The month is secondary-source information; confirm the selected cluster’s contractual timing and any subsequent developer update.
